raw_evidence: Crews were already dealing with a large wildfire near Oldham on Wednesday when a semi-detached house also went up in flames in south Manchester the next day A raft of fires across the country, including devastating blazes in the West Midlands, later prompted the government to issue a temporary ban on disposable barbecues Greater Manchester's Chief Fire Officer Dave Russel thanked crews for their work in an "exceptionally busy period" while his deputy Jim Willmott said firefighters had received 1,200 calls on Thursday Willmott told BBC Radio Manchester : "Yesterday I was in the fire control room for North West Fire Control - it really was the most incredibly busy period I have ever seen in my 26 years of service." Earlier in the month crews stood down from wildfires on two stretches of moorland near Dove Stone Reservoir and at Tintwistle and Swineshore The fire chief said a lot of the recent incidents were "very reminiscent of the prolonged wildfires of 2018 and some we saw in 2022"
